status: PASS: observed native combined mechanism on ranks 0/1; causal event waits and full-update critical path unavailable
scope: Update 21, three complete consecutive F+B microbatches/rank, within 32-microbatch accumulation. Diagnostic run completed all 21 optimizer updates on eight ranks. CPU/MCP analysis only; no new GPU work or numerical policy.

method.ownership: CPU/FQN scope -> descendant runtime/driver launch -> actual flow -> device endpoint; every correlation matches uniquely.
method.readiness: FFN compiled backward identified by exactly three Avec128_Bvec128_TNT kernels, w2/w3/w1 order inherited from pinned generated FFN mapping; triton_poi_fused_add_3 completes dInput. Actual device endpoints precede FP32 foreach packing and FFN NCCL.
method.overlap: Clipped interval union of FFN RS intersecting kernels owned by the immediately following parent CompiledFunctionBackward; no memcpy/memset/NCCL included.
method.units: Device timestamps/durations ns; derived intervals ms. Payloads are logical input/output elements/bytes, not physical network traffic. NCCL duration can contain peer waiting.

acceptance.exact_event_wait_causality: Not observable; source and existing delayed-collective tests remain lifecycle-safety basis.

identity.activation: Resolved controls plus same-fingerprint materialized native B001 all-eight-rank inventory and actual profiled child RS / _OwnerLookup execution. Absent setup INFO text is not used as a failed activation marker.

sql.census: SELECT category,count(*) AS n,sum(dur)/1e6 AS ms FROM slice GROUP BY category ORDER BY category
sql.scopes: SELECT id,name,ts,dur,track_id,parent_id FROM slice WHERE category IN ('user_annotation','cpu_op') AND (name GLOB '*OwnerLookup*' OR name GLOB '*CompiledFunctionBackward*' OR name GLOB 'GFSDP::*' OR name GLOB 'task.profile_update*' OR name GLOB '*embedding_dense_backward*') ORDER BY ts
sql.flows: SELECT count(*) AS endpoints,count(DISTINCT k.id) AS distinct_device,sum(CASE WHEN extract_arg(k.arg_set_id,'args.correlation')=extract_arg(h.arg_set_id,'args.correlation') THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS matching_correlation FROM slice k JOIN flow f ON f.slice_in=k.id JOIN slice h ON h.id=f.slice_out WHERE k.category IN ('kernel','gpu_memcpy','gpu_memset')
sql.errors: SELECT name,value,severity FROM stats WHERE value<>0 AND (severity='error' OR name GLOB '*drop*')
sql.device: SELECT k.id,k.name,k.ts,k.dur,k.category,extract_arg(k.arg_set_id,'args.stream') AS stream,h.id AS launch_id,h.ts AS launch_ts,h.name AS launch_name,(SELECT group_concat(a.id||':'||a.name,' > ') FROM ancestor_slice(h.id) a) AS ancestors,extract_arg(k.arg_set_id,'args.In msg nelems') AS input_elements,extract_arg(k.arg_set_id,'args.Out msg nelems') AS output_elements,extract_arg(k.arg_set_id,'args.dtype') AS dtype,extract_arg(k.arg_set_id,'args.Group size') AS group_size,extract_arg(k.arg_set_id,'args.Seq') AS sequence FROM slice k LEFT JOIN flow f ON f.slice_in=k.id LEFT JOIN slice h ON h.id=f.slice_out WHERE k.category IN ('kernel','gpu_memcpy','gpu_memset') ORDER BY k.ts
sql.owner_host_waits: SELECT o.id AS owner_scope,o.name AS owner_name,s.name,count(*) AS n,sum(s.dur)/1e6 AS host_span_ms FROM slice o JOIN slice s ON s.track_id=o.track_id AND s.ts>=o.ts AND s.ts<o.ts+o.dur WHERE o.name IN ('_OwnerLookup','_OwnerLookupBackward') AND s.category IN ('cuda_runtime','cuda_driver') AND (s.name GLOB '*Synchronize*' OR s.name GLOB '*Memcpy*' OR s.name GLOB '*WaitEvent*') GROUP BY 1,2,3 ORDER BY 1,3

limits: Only ranks 0/1 and three of 32 microbatches were profiled; existing eight-rank component/readiness tests retain their own scope. No eight-rank native device trace claim.

CUDA event/stream wait handles are absent; positive temporal separation does not identify which release event a wait consumes or prove causality. Source borrow/wait_for_release and existing delayed-NCCL pending-reader tests complement the trace.
No full-update critical path, optimizer device timing, causal throughput or additive speedup is inferred from this bounded profile. Unprofiled timing and memory have separate result owners.

Request distribution is concentrated on owner rank 0; rank 1 has zero incoming owned rows. Fixture/skew/duplicates/empty and derivative equivalence coverage remains owned by the accepted component/state tests.
Native BF16 full-table source coalescing scratch, unique/sort dynamic-output DtoH, count DtoH and synchronization remain. Table transport removal does not remove these costs.

Trunk/MTP reuse follows inspected decoder source and the once-per-MB lookup/backward profile; operands/individual derivative contributions are not recorded. Exact shared-consumer derivative is covered by existing tests; no numerical investigation was reopened.

Keep original timestamps, durations, names, arguments (including actual args.stream), CPU events and trace metadata. Source bytes are unchanged.
